Upper Text: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 blue Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] When any of your blue Tamers are played, this Digimon unsuspends.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon unsuspends, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon to the hand. For each of your blue Tamers, add 1 to this effect's level maximum.
